newsitem.title: POLAND: Poland moves deadline for Swiecie bids to Nov 18.
newsitem.headline: Poland moves deadline for Swiecie bids to Nov 18.

text.p: The Polish treasury ministry extended the deadline for initial offers for a 60 percent stake in the Swiecie paper company to November 18, an official from the firm advising the treasury on the sale said on Friday.
"The deadline for placing initial bids for Swiecie by strategic investors has been extended until November 18 on the request of the investors," Dariusz Olszewski told Reuters.

Apart from the strategic majority stake, the treasury wants to float between 10 and 20 percent of Swiecie, which has more than 25 percent of the Polish paper market and employs 3,250, on the Warsaw Stock Exchange.
The company's employees will get 15 percent of the shares free and the treasury will retain five percent for reprivatisation claims.
Olszewski, deputy head of the Towarzystwo Doradztwa Inwestycyjnego Ltd. said the flotation was likely to take place in the first quarter of next year.
He said Swiecie was currently preparing an issue prospectus which it would soon submit to the Polish Securities Commission.
